description:
SGP is seeking experienced Proposal Managers and Proposal Writers to drive and develop compliant, compelling responses to federal RFPs, RFIs, and task order requests. You will lead proposals from kickoff through submission, in some cases owning key proposal volumes as a writer, collaborating with client capture leads, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and pricing teams.

You’ll bring experience working successfully as a 1099 consultant and the ability to support varying clients with distinct processes, tools, cultures, and deadlines. You’ll have a track record of collaborating with capture managers and coordinators, proposal coordinators, editors, graphic designers, and pricing and contracts staff to deliver cohesive, competitive submissions.

Workplace Type: Remote.

Compensation: 1099 Consultant. $95 -$110 per hour.

Security Clearance: Active Security Clearance.

Why Join the SGP Capture & Proposals Team

As an SGP consultant, you’ll retain the independence of contract work while accessing a collaborative network of resources to support successful engagements.

  • Select consultant network: Join a network of experienced capture and proposal professionals who have diverse expertise and collaborate to support client needs across a variety of engagements.

  • The right fit, by design: We strive to align each consultant with client engagements that complement their professional expertise, career interests, and working styles, creating opportunities for meaningful contributions and successful collaboration.

  • Referral bonuses: Earn referral incentives for introducing prospective clients and qualified consultants to the SGP network, subject to program eligibility requirements.

  • Resources that raise the bar: Access optional professional development opportunities, established templates, industry best practices, and support from experienced professionals to strengthen the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • Flexibility and choice: Enjoy the flexibility of remote consulting and the opportunity to accept engagements that align with your availability, expertise, and professional interests.

  • Modern, AI-enabled workflows: Collaborate with a team that combines extensive federal contracting expertise with modern technologies and evolving AI-assisted tools and processes to support efficient, high-quality proposal development.

  • Breadth of experience: Gain exposure to a variety of federal agencies, contract vehicles, and clients, ranging from emerging small businesses to established government contractors.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze solicitations (Sections L, M, C, PWS/SOW) and develop compliance matrices and annotated outlines

  • Develop proposal schedules, assignments, and storyboards; facilitate kickoff meetings, status calls, and color team reviews

  • Write and edit technical, management, staffing, and past performance volumes

  • Translate capture strategies, win themes, and discriminators into persuasive, evaluator-focused content

  • Interview SMEs and translate technical input into clear, compliant narratives

  • Coordinate with pricing, contracts, and graphics teams to ensure consistency across proposal volumes

  • Oversee final production, quality checks, and timely submission

Required qualifications

  • At least 5 years of experience in federal proposal management and proposal writing

  • Demonstrated experience managing or contributing to full proposal lifecycles for commercial, state, local and federal proposal responses

  • Strong understanding of proposal best practices

  • Excellent writing, editing, and organizational skills under tight deadlines

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint

Preferred qualifications

  • APMP Foundation-level, Practitioner, or Professional certification

  • Experience supporting proposals across multiple federal agencies (e.g., DoD, DHS, HHS, VA, and other civilian agencies)

  • Experience developing task order responses under GSA MAS, OASIS+, SEWP, CIO-SP, or other federal contract vehicles

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted proposal development tools and proposal management platforms

  • Active security clearance.
